# Model soak

<!-- Generated by `npm run soak:model` on commit 91127b1. Do not edit by hand. -->

Label: **real model, hosted**. Site: `https://order-forge.afras.dev`. Date: 2026-11-06T11:16:10.816Z. Store: `demo-gift-boxes`.

Model: `openai/gpt-oss-120b`, as stated by the person who ran this (the public flow does not reveal which model answered).

Method: 10 requests, one at a time, through the public customer flow in a real browser (open the store page, type a fixed prepared request, press "Start my request", wait for the order room). The time is from the button press to the order room, which the app shows only after the assistant has answered or failed. A request counts as **answered** if the order room shows no hand-off message, **handoff** if it shows that the assistant could not answer, **error** for anything else (a blocked page, a timeout of the browser). The limit for a pass is 20.0 s each. Each request leaves one throwaway request in the shop's inbox.

## Result

**Pass.** 10 of 10 requests were answered by the model, none took longer than 20.0 s (slowest 14.3 s, median 10.5 s).

## What this does not show

It does not measure answer quality (see `doc/evidence/ai-intake-real-model.md` for that), it uses one fixed message, and a run of 10 says how this model behaved at the time of the run, not how it will behave later.
